title.en: An Act Establishing a Filipino War Memorial and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Filipino War Memorial and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5679_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of one million pesos for the establishment of a Filipino War Memorial at the Government Center in Quezon City or wherever the President of the Philippines shall deem it proper to establish, so as to house the relics, documentary and photographic records, paintings, the weapons and ammunition used in war, as well as models, statues and other war memorials.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
